reason: This plugin is primarily a chat navigation UX utility: it adds a compact message minimap rail in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view to help locate user messages in long threads, with hover previews and jump/drag positioning. Evidence from the readme and package metadata shows a web client UI extension plus a host API endpoint for session message summaries, with graceful DOM-only fallback when the API cannot be used.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的聊天窗口左侧提供用户消息导向栏，支持悬停查看摘要并通过点击或拖拽快速定位到历史消息。
summaries.en: Provides a compact message minimap in the DeepSeek Harness chat view, with hover previews and click-or-drag controls to quickly locate and jump to historical messages.

capabilities: Injects a web chat UI rail for message navigation.
Reads chat DOM anchors and viewport/scroll state to map message positions.
Optionally requests a host API for full user-message summaries from local session logs.
Supports click/drag interactions to jump or sweep through long conversations.
Falls back to DOM-only mode when the API is unavailable or restricted.

reasons.code: README documents a left-edge minimap for DeepSeek Harness chat, with hover previews and click/drag navigation over user-message ticks, and a host route `/api/message-minimap-messages` for unloaded history.
package.json declares a DSH web plugin with host/client entrypoints (`lib/index.js` and `./client`) and web client injection, indicating dual-hosted functionality.
Repository structure lists `lib/index.js` as the server half and `lib/client.js` as the browser half, with data sourced from session logs and no build artifacts required.
